changelog: Turn YouTube insurance captions into one talking insurance clip per still.

en.description: Turn YouTube insurance captions into one talking insurance clip per still. This YouTube insurance caption studio reads public captions, then records each already-written clause line as a 2 to 15s talking clip. Those insurance talking clips stay separate files they can send on their own.
en.summary: Turn YouTube insurance captions into one talking insurance clip per still.
en.title: YouTube Insurance Caption Talking: One Still, One Clause Read
